_note: Editable projection inputs. Measured pilot values come from pilot_calls.jsonl and pilot_runs.json; everything here is an assumption or a corpus count computed from the CSVs.

declared_100k_subset.label: Declared final scope: data/subset_100k.csv (course sampler rule + seed extended to 100,050 nonempty rows, plus all 13 empty texts)

modeled_alt_haiku_batch_api.note: MODELED, not run: applies Haiku 4.5 Batch rates to the local pilot's token profile (tokenizers differ). Cache hit 0 because Batch prompt caching is best-effort.

modeled_alt_haiku_standard.note: MODELED, not run: Haiku 4.5 standard rates on the local pilot's token profile, no prompt-cache savings assumed.

local_compute.basis: ASSUMPTIONS, not measured: ~25 W sustained package power for an 8 GB Apple M1 during GPU inference, and an illustrative US-West residential electricity price. Hardware wear and the owner's time are not priced (unknown).

rate_limits.source: Local Ollama server: no provider rate limit; throughput is bounded by measured latency per request and worker count.

worker_decision: 1 worker. Measured on 2026-10-06 with the same 50 cost_100 reviews: 1 request took ~60 s warm; 3 concurrent requests on a 3-slot Ollama server took 347 s for 150 reviews (2.3 s/review vs 1.2 s/review), so parallel slots are slower on this 8 GB M1.
local_compute_note: The default configuration runs every model role on a local Ollama model, so measured API spend is $0. That is not the same as free: local inference uses this laptop's time, memory and electricity. Electricity is estimated from the editable local_compute assumptions; hardware wear is unknown and not priced. Roles switched to Anthropic in config/pipeline.json are billed from provider-reported usage x cost/rates.csv.
